::: {#def-nffrcistg .theorem}
# Network FFRCISTG

A NFFRCISTG is a FFRCISTG associated with a graph. Each node in the graph represents an observational unit in the FFRCISTG. A network tie indicates a pair of observational units whose measures are causes of each other. All the structural equations in this model have exposure mappings which are separable with well-defined and bounded network exposure mappings and independent errors.

:::
